ORDER TO CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-04-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUN-08-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF JUSTIN AND SUZETTE ARMENTA ARE PRESENT AND REPRESENTED BY JUSTIN ARMENTA. DEFENDANT THE FUTON SHOP COSTA MESA, LLC IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF STATES THAT THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT HAS NOT BEEN COMPLETED. HONORABLE PANG LY ALLOWS FOR ANOTHER 30 DAYS FOR PARTIES TO COMPLETED THEIER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT AT THE MARCH 29TH HEARING; THE COURT ALLOWS ANOTHER 30 DAY CONTINUANCE TO COMPLETE THE PREVIOUS SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE JUN-8-2023 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PUSUANT TO SETTLMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: MANI SHEIK; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-29-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAY-04-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF JUSTIN ARMENTA IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. PLAINTIFF SUZETTE ARMENTA VIA UNAUTHORIZED ZOOM. DEFENDANT THE FUTON SHOP COSTA MESA,L.L.C IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY EDITH RIVERA (SUPERVISOR FOR CONSUMER SERVICE) VIA UNAUTHORIZED ZOOM. COURT ALLOWS PLAINTIFFS AND DEFENDANT APPEARANCE BY ZOOM AS PLAINTIFFS AND DEFENDANT BOTH AGREED TO PROCEED TO CONDUCT THE TRIAL BY ZOOM. PARTIES REACHED A SETTLEMENT WHEREBY DEFENDANT SHALL PAY PLAINTIFFS $5,000 VIA A CHECK TO BE MAILED TO PLAINTIFF'S HOME ADDRESS ON FILE. PLAINTIFFS AGREE TO COORDINATE WITH DEFENDANT TO ALLOW THEM TO PICK UP THE SOFA. PROGRESS REPORT SET FOR MAY-04, 2023 AT 3:30 P.M. IN DEPT 506. IF THERE IS NO APPEARANCE, THEN CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE ("DWP"). IF THERE IS AN APPEARANCE, HEARING WILL BE CONDUCTED FOR JUDGEMENT DECISION. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
